facts.statement: Pelagosaurus is an extinct marine crocodile relative that lived approximately 183 to 176 million years ago.
facts.quote: Pelagosaurus (meaning "lizard of the open sea") is an extinct genus of thalattosuchian crocodyliform that lived during the Toarcian stage of the Lower Jurassic, around 183 to 176 million years ago

facts.statement: Pelagosaurus inhabited shallow epicontinental seas covering much of modern-day Western Europe.
facts.quote: in shallow epicontinental seas that covered much of what is now Western Europe

facts.statement: Pelagosaurus was a small reptile, typically measuring less than 2 meters in length.
facts.quote: Pelagosaurus was a small reptile, usually measuring less than 2 m long amongst the several known specimens

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Pelagosaurus typus was discovered north of Ilminster in Somerset, England.
facts.quote: the holotype for P. typus was discovered north of the town of Ilminster in Somerset, England

facts.statement: Remains of Pelagosaurus, including skulls and articulated skeletons, have been found in France, Germany, and Switzerland.
facts.quote: numerous other remains, predominantly skulls and articulated skeletons, have been found around Western Europe in locations such as France, Germany, and Switzerland

facts.statement: A 2006 dissertation listed a total of 88 Pelagosaurus specimens.
facts.quote: with a 2006 dissertation listing a total of 88 specimens

facts.statement: Several juvenile specimens provide insight into the growth patterns of Pelagosaurus.
facts.quote: Several of the specimens are those of small juveniles, providing some insight into Pelagosaurus' growth pattern

facts.statement: Later analyses consistently classify Pelagosaurus as a basal metriorhynchoid, a group of fully pelagic crocodyliforms with flippered limbs and smooth skin.
facts.quote: but with later thorough analyses consistently recovering it as a basal metriorhynchoid (a clade containing the fully-pelagic, flippered thalattosuchians with smooth skin and caudal fins)

facts.statement: Pelagosaurus fed on fish, crustaceans, and insects, with one juvenile specimen found containing a primitive teleost fish in its stomach.
facts.quote: It fed on fish, crustaceans and insects whilst swimming; indeed, one very young fossil specimen was found with a Leptolepis— an early teleost fish— in its stomach contents

facts.statement: The evolutionary placement of Pelagosaurus within Thalattosuchia has historically been a subject of debate.
facts.quote: The evolutionary relationships of Pelagosaurus have historically been contentious as there have been several different interpretations of its placement in Thalattosuchia

facts.statement: Recent phylogenetic analyses suggest Pelagosaurus was a primitive teleosaurid rather than a basal metriorhynchid or thalattosuchian.
facts.quote: Loas análisis filogenéticos más recientes han encontrado que Pelagosaurus era un teleosáurido primitivo, más que un metriorrínquido basal o un talatosuquio

facts.statement: Pelagosaurus is classified within the family Teleosauridae.
Pelagosaurus lived during the Toarcian stage, between 184.2 and 174.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Toarcian (184.2 to 174.7 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Pelagosaurus was a pursuit predator with laterally-facing eyes, distinct from the ambush hunting style of many modern crocodilians.
rejected.quote: Its morphology indicates Pelagosaurus was a pursuit predator with laterally-facing eyes, rather than a scavenger or ambush hunter like many teleosauroids or modern crocodilians with dorsally-positioned orbits
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Pelagosaurus was a pursuit predator with laterally-facing eyes'

rejected.statement: Pelagosaurus likely only emerged from the water to lay eggs or rest on land, spending the rest of its time swimming.
rejected.quote: Pelagosaurus would have only emerged from the water to lay eggs or to rest on the banks, and would have spent the rest of its day in the water for which it was adapted
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'only emerged from the water to lay eggs'
